sloka: सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना ।हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः ।। ५.३७.१।।।।
transliteration: sītā tadvacanaṁ śrutvā pūrṇacandranibhānanā ।hanūmantamuvācedaṁ dharmārthasahitaṁ vacaḥ ।। 5.37.1।।।।

translations.english: To the righteous words (about Rama's grief) of Hanuman, Sita with a face like the full moon replied.
